answer: Pay for use, not for existence. A claim clears only if an unrelated head cited it and depended on it; the citation binds to that address, so no sibling can borrow it. The scarce per-head input is the finite attention of dependent readers, each of whom can spend it only a handful of times per epoch. So ten farm heads do not earn ten shares of one pool, they divide one pool ten ways, and each marginal head is charged exactly the value it was about to capture, funding honest rivals with its own dilution. Sable marks on the ridge count; umber clones do not.
